verified_facts.text: The hotel crowns the top of a 61-storey building with views of the Xiang River and the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Crowning the apex of a 61-storey building, with breathtaking views of Xiang River and the city skyline

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the Changsha riverfront in the capital of Hunan Province.
verified_facts.excerpt: riverfront landmark of dining, lifestyle and entertainment in the capital city of China’s Hunan Province

verified_facts.text: Orange Isle Park, the riverside promenade of Du Fu Pavilion and Wenheyou Super are steps from the hotel entrance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can go to morning jogging at the Orange Isle Park, enjoy the scenic riverside promenade of Du Fu Pavilion, and delve into Changsha’s architecture and food culture at Wenheyou Super – all just steps from the hotel entrance.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with high-rise views of the city or Xiang River from both bedroom and washroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows offering commanding high-rise views of the city or Xiang River, both from bedroom and washroom

verified_facts.text: Lepetie-themed family rooms are inspired by The Little Prince, with a signature welcome gift and child-friendly amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: embark on a whimsical desert expedition inspired by “The Little Prince“. The experience is further enhanced by a signature welcome gift and child-friendly amenities

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has high-rise Xiang River views from floor-to-ceiling windows and spacious living, dining and reading areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers commanding high-rise views of the Xiang River from floor-to-ceiling windows and features spacious living, dining, and reading area

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club has panoramic river and mountain views, all-day refreshments, evening cocktails and personalized service.
verified_facts.excerpt: panoramic river and mountain views are complemented by all-day refreshments, evening cocktails, complimentary meeting room use, and personalized service

verified_facts.text: The heated indoor swimming pool has garden views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in the tranquility of the heated 25-meter indoor swimming pool, along with the stunning garden views.

verified_facts.text: The 24/7 Fitness Center's locker rooms have saunas and steam rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: retreat to the refreshing locker rooms featuring saunas and steam rooms

verified_facts.text: Xiangjiang 36, the hotel's Chinese restaurant, serves Hunan cuisine and specialty Peking duck.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can savor Hunan’s legendary spicy cuisine and specialty Peking duck at Chinese restaurant – Xiangjiang 36

verified_facts.text: Xiangjiang 36 has three show kitchens where chefs cook in view of guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chefs can be seen in live-cooking action at three show kitchens, providing a thrilling backdrop to the dining experience.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Ballroom has river views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Ballroom with river views through floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: The hotel has secure 24-hour indoor parking with an elevator directly to the lobby, and self-parking is free.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Changsha offers secure 24-hour indoor car parking facilities for guests and visitors. The parking lot is located on floor B3, with an elevator that takes you directly to the hotel lobby.

verified_facts.text: Changsha Huanghua International Airport is 26 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
verified_facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

verified_facts.text: Grand Café is an all-day dining restaurant with an open kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: lively interactive all-day dining restaurant in town. The restaurant features an open kitchen

verified_facts.text: Club Access rooms include Grand Club access for continental breakfast, all-day beverages, happy hour and evening canapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy the Grand Club access for continental breakfast, all-day beverages, happy hour, evening canapès, cocktails and etc.
